newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures closed higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures closed higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Wednesday, in line with price gains in the U.S. soybean futures market here, traders said.
Prices were 190 to 440 yen higher, with the benchmark November 1997 contract up 230 yen at 14,240 yen a tonne. Volume was 48,702 lots.
Local investors started buying from the opening session, encouraged by price gains in yen-based U.S. soybean futures market here, traders said.
"Investors are shifting their money to soybean from corn," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading corn system was being traded at $2.74 per bushel at 0855 GMT, against $2.74-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
The spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.99-1/4 at 0855 GMT, against $6.98-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
